scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory movement ledger report/export

criteria.description: The ledger grain, exact thirteen-field contract, raw movement semantics, filters, permission, bound and non-promotion exclusions are frozen.
criteria.limitations: Vetus evidence establishes the report surface, not an authoritative dynamic-executor schema; the bounded local contract is explicit about that limitation.

criteria.description: Existing tenant-scoped inventory_stock_movements and inventory_items persistence plus ReportsService provide an additive implementation path without a migration.
criteria.limitations: The current repository query needs report-specific filtering, deterministic tie-breaking and an explicit disabled stock-movement capability check before it is implementation-ready in code.

criteria.description: Focused TDD and disposable PostgreSQL/browser evidence can prove exact mapping, tenant isolation, filter semantics, fail-closed behavior, durable audit and server-side SPA export.
criteria.limitations: Implementation, fresh verification and independent critique are required before a bounded result is recorded.

gaps: The RED tests, implementation, disposable database/browser proof, independent critique and post-implementation regression are not complete at gate creation.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief and explicit continuation request
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory movement ledger report/export

Exclude lots, consumptions, inventory-invoices/NF semantics, scheduled delivery, historical/as-of valuation, providers, fiscal writes, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill and release acceptance.
